notes: Protocol-amendment/development sentinel; excluded from primary independent-validation estimates. G1-G4 passed prospectively; G4 recorded PASS_WITH_QC_WARNING. Under A1.1, 7172 SPAdes path records yielded 3588 unique contiguous directed graph-walk chunks after 4 missing-edge observations representing 2 unique absent transitions. Neither endpoint achieved the frozen >=95% query coverage and >=98% identity criterion on a contiguous directed walk. Best left-anchor hits were 143/250 nt and 101/250 nt at 100% identity on separate states corresponding to segments 57411- and 66559-; best right-anchor hit was 200/250 nt at 100% identity on segment 85465-. Directed topology diagnostics found no path among 66559-, 57411-, and 85465-. No threshold, anchor length, or rescue rule was altered. No BGCPhaser score, truth rank, chemistry outcome, or MIBiG similarity rank was inspected. A diagnostic helper initially queried column `oriented_path` although the chunk table uses `oriented_walk`; that diagnostic-only mismatch did not affect the G5 result.
